channel.title: The Latin Wire
channel.description: Politics, business, entertainment, sports and culture for Hispanics

item.title: Mexico's Sheinbaum sends digital economy payments bill to Congress
item.description: Sheinbaum's digital payments bill reaches Congress, targeting a gradual shift away from cash across government agencies and private businesses.

item.title: Peso Pluma leads 2026 Billboard Latin Music Awards with 17 nods
item.description: The regional Mexican star dominates the 2026 finalist list while a new Fan Artist of the Year category puts voting power in the hands of the public.

item.title: Trump says Iran war and high oil prices will end after midterms
item.description: Trump's prediction that war and high oil prices end after the midterms raises durable questions about energy vulnerability, strategic reserves, and how conflicts end.

item.title: Peso Pluma leads 2026 Billboard Latin Music Awards with 17 nods
item.description: The Mexican regional star leads all nominees heading into the October 22 ceremony in Miami, nearly doubling his own nomination count from last year.

item.title: Inflatable slide deploys on Air Force One, briefly delaying Trump's Dallas trip
item.description: An emergency slide deployed from the front of the Qatari-gifted Boeing 747-8 before Trump could board, delaying his departure by roughly 15 to 20 minutes.

item.title: Emergency slide deploys on Qatar-gifted Air Force One before Dallas departure
item.description: An emergency inflatable slide deployed from the Qatar-gifted aircraft at Joint Base Andrews, briefly grounding President Trump before his departure for Dallas.

item.title: RDEco panel debates natural resources and SME transformation in Argentina
item.description: Four economists on Argentina's +Perfil channel weighed natural resources and SME struggles, warning a two-speed economy could deepen inequality.

item.title: GOP and Trump administration pressure Ford to cut China ties
item.description: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy urged Ford to sever its relationships with CATL, Geely, and BYD, calling the ties unsustainable for the United States.

item.title: Fetterman praises Trump in GOP convention video; Pritzker holds counterprogramming
item.description: Fetterman appeared via video at the Republican National Midterm Convention in Dallas, while Illinois Gov. Pritzker held nearby counter-programming denouncing GOP election strategy.

item.title: Inter Miami visit Chicago Fire in MLS Matchday 25 clash
item.description: Inter Miami carry a 10-point deficit to Nashville SC into Wednesday's Eastern Conference clash against third-place Chicago Fire at Soldier Field.

item.title: Missouri congressional map fight returns to U.S. Supreme Court
item.description: A tangled collision of state and federal authority over Missouri's congressional map raises questions that stretch well beyond one election cycle.

item.title: Argentina's economy grows unevenly as industry and jobs lag
item.description: GDP forecasts fall to 2.4–2.7%, far short of the government's 5% target, as farm and energy gains mask deep industrial pain.

item.title: Hoskins seeks federal block on Missouri Supreme Court contempt hearing
item.description: Missouri Secretary of State Denny Hoskins filed an emergency federal request Wednesday to block a state Supreme Court contempt hearing set for Thursday.

item.title: Rafa Márquez set for formal unveiling as Mexico head coach
item.description: FMF sets September 10 unveiling for Rafa Márquez, who takes over El Tri after Mexico's 2026 World Cup exit against England.

item.title: Salvadoran TPS expires Sept. 9, leaving 200,000 immigrants in limbo
item.description: The longest-running Temporary Protected Status designation in U.S. history lapsed September 9, leaving roughly 200,000 Salvadoran immigrants without clarity on their legal standing.

item.title: Ancelotti names overhauled Brazil squad for Australia and India friendlies
item.description: Carlo Ancelotti kept only nine World Cup players and dropped Alisson, Casemiro, and Neymar as Brazil resets for the 2030 cycle.

item.title: Messi reaches deal to buy Spanish second-division club Eldense
item.description: The Argentine star is paying roughly $12 million for 100% of CD Eldense, his second Spanish club acquisition this year.

item.title: Trump proposes excluding non-permanent immigrants from 2030 census
item.description: A Commerce Department proposal would restrict the 2030 census count to citizens and lawful permanent residents, drawing legal challenges over the 14th Amendment.

item.title: Treasury's $6B bond buyback drives yields to three-year high
item.description: The Treasury Department's expanded bond buyback program sent 10-year yields to their highest level since 2023, as investors signaled disappointment with the scope of the intervention.

item.title: States urge Supreme Court to keep USPS mail ballot rule blocked
item.description: A coalition of 24 states and D.C. asked the Supreme Court on Sept. 9 to keep blocked a USPS mail-ballot rule ahead of November midterms.

item.title: Hispanic Heritage Month 2026 kicks off across the United States
item.description: From coast to coast, the United States celebrates Hispanic Heritage Month 2026 under the theme 'Pioneers of Change: Shaping the Future Together.'

item.title: Mexico submits 2027 economic package to Congress
item.description: Finance Secretary Édgar Amador Zamora delivered Mexico's 2027 Economic Package to Congress on September 8, projecting faster growth and a narrower deficit.

item.title: Messi pursues Spanish club ownership after retiring from Argentina
item.description: Messi retires from Argentina after 125 goals and a World Cup title, then moves toward owning CD Eldense in Spain's second division.

item.title: Shakira names guest artists for Madrid Es Latina residency
item.description: The Colombian superstar revealed a sweeping cultural festival built around her Madrid residency, featuring ten established acts and a park named after a literary legend.

item.title: New Hampshire primaries set Sununu-Pappas Senate race and Shaheen House bid
item.description: Two primary nights in New Hampshire reveal a Senate race with deep roots and a House contest that exposed real fault lines within the Democratic Party.

item.title: Brazil names 26-man squad for Australia and India friendlies
item.description: Carlo Ancelotti names a 26-man Brazil squad for friendlies in Australia and India, the first senior men's match between the two nations.

item.title: Trump's 9/11 firefighter rescue story draws denials and pushback
item.description: President Trump's claim that firefighters carried him from a collapsing building after 9/11 faces denials and a lack of corroborating evidence.

item.title: Mexico's 2027 budget cuts Pemex debt transfers by 70%
item.description: President Sheinbaum's 2027 budget slashes federal debt transfers to Pemex by nearly 70%, pushing the oil giant toward financial self-sufficiency.

item.title: OLA's Latino Film Festival of the Hamptons returns for 23rd year
item.description: OLA of Eastern Long Island brings four films from Colombia, Cuba, Mexico, and the U.S. to the Hamptons this September under the theme 'Courage and Truth.'

item.title: Colombia's cheap dollar era faces end amid El Niño and fiscal risks
item.description: The peso gained 17% in 2026, but analysts warn fiscal stress, El Niño, and a Fed decision could reverse the run fast.

item.title: Bessent touts Treasury dollars as foreign policy tool in Latin America
item.description: Bessent calls Treasury's balance sheet a foreign policy tool, citing Argentina; Mexico's Sheinbaum draws a sovereignty line on USMCA talks.

item.title: Congress scrambles on AI safety after Anthropic researcher quits
item.description: A researcher's resignation warning of catastrophic AI risk has accelerated congressional action and raised the stakes for 2026 midterm candidates.

item.title: CNN polls show Democrats narrowly leading in Maine and Michigan Senate races
item.description: New CNN polling shows Democratic challengers holding narrow leads over Republican incumbents in two key Senate battleground states.

item.title: Polls show Senate races in Michigan, Maine, New Hampshire tightening
item.description: Senate contests in Michigan, Maine, and New Hampshire are tightening heading into fall, with multiple polls showing races within their margins of error.

item.title: AP, South Park defy Trump's Lake Ontario rename; White House pulls game
item.description: The AP and South Park's creators declined to adopt the Trump administration's 'Lake America' designation, while the White House pulled a Tetris-style game after a copyright complaint.

item.title: Ibama clears Petrobras to drill three more Foz do Amazonas wells
item.description: Brazil's environmental regulator cleared Petrobras to drill three wells at the Morpho discovery site, 175 kilometers off Amapá, less than three weeks after a hydrocarbon find.

item.title: Republicans open first-ever midterm convention in Dallas
item.description: The GOP's first-ever midterm convention rewrites a century-old political tradition — and raises questions that will outlast the Dallas spectacle.

item.title: Republicans hold Dallas midterm convention amid polls showing declining trust
item.description: The RNC opened what it called a historic two-night midterm convention in Dallas as a new poll showed growing public mistrust of federal government information.

item.title: Mexico inflation rises to 3.26% in August, breaking three-month decline
item.description: August inflation snapped a three-month slide but came in under forecasts, leaving Banxico with little pressure to move rates.

item.title: DHS says Salvadoran TPS holders retain protection as designation expires
item.description: DHS says Salvadoran TPS holders remain protected past the September 9 expiration as no Federal Register determination was published by the statutory deadline.
